verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a link from a funnel drop-off step or an error event to the session replays of the affected users. The nearby claims are different features: replays include a DevTools panel showing errors, feature-flag pages link to replays of flagged users, LLM traces link to replays, and PostHog AI can find a replay on request. None of these is the funnel-to-replay or error-to-replay jump the story asks for.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can jump from a funnel drop-off or an error event straight to session replays of the affected users
